 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Dave Fontenot, founder of HF0. Born out of Dave's experiences in monasteries across the world, HF0 is a 12-week residency for repeat founders to supercharge their next venture. For three months, 10 teams of engineers relocate to HF0's house in San Francisco.

 During the residency, everything is taken care of, so their sole focus is on building. It's one of the most interesting incubators I've come across, and we discuss the model and its monastic origins in detail. Please enjoy this conversation with Dave Fontenot.

 Monastic Life and Removing Distractions 
 Patrick 
What was the pathway to the monastery?

 Dave 
In retrospect, it's much clearer. It was my first major heartbreak. In the moment, I didn't know that this was the reason why. But looking back, I couldn't handle it. I have a pretty severe ADD. And so I was on ADD medication, and I blamed being on the medication for things not working out.
